basis: Lilly seventh-house marriage judgment: querent signified by Mercury, retrograde and under the Sun-beams = she is weak, obscured and in no position to compel the matter, and the match will not be of her making; the quesited's significator in his exaltation, near the sextile of Venus = he stands upon high terms, is proud of his condition, and has been in dalliance/tampering with another woman (Venus). The two significators are only in semi-sextile (a weak, non-perfecting familiarity) but both in good houses, so there is inclination without a direct perfected aspect between them; perfection is supplied by the Moon, who separates from a square of Jupiter (the quesited's side) and applies by trine to Mercury, lord of the Ascendant — a translation/carrying of light from the man's significator to the woman's, which in Lilly's rules brings the matter to pass through a mediator. Hence: marriage follows, but on the man's high terms and after his other dalliance, not swiftly or on her terms.
prediction_text: She will marry the man she desires — but on his terms, not hers. He stands high, is exalted and self-satisfied, and has been tampering with another woman (his significator near Venus), while she (Mercury retrograde under the Sun-beams) is weak and obscured in the suit. The significators meet only by the Moon's translation of light — separating from Jupiter's square and carrying his light by trine to Mercury — so the marriage is brought about through mediation/intercession rather than by her direct power, after delay.
timing: Month scale: window of the coming months while the Moon's translation completes and the man's Venus dalliance runs out; main coordinate after a delay of months (no degree count is stated in the prose, so no single day is asserted)
